name: zsnd_cd_get_volume
description: zSndCd::GetVolume reads AUX volume when CD audio is ready, updates cached primary and secondary volumes, and maps mono AUX output to both channels.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred for the coherent zSndCd source-file cluster.
functional_evidence: Current Binary Ninja decompilation for 0x4a27f0 returns zero when the CD-ready flag is clear, calls IsStereoAuxEnabled, calls auxGetVolume with g_zSndCdAuxDeviceId, reports line 0x194 on AUX failure, caches the low word as the primary volume, maps mono AUX to both outputs, and maps stereo AUX high word to the secondary output.

Native smoke zsnd_cd_get_volume_smoke patches auxGetVolume and verifies the not-ready guard, mono output mapping, stereo output mapping, cached globals, AUX device argument, and AUX failure return path.
